optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the model evaluation harness and the labelled adviser-review set.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the evaluation harness (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner) and the labelled review set of adviser-confirmed alerts, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year.

professionalSummary.text: Runs pre-release evaluations for each model version and publishes the evaluation report.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the four model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report to the model team and adviser operations.

professionalSummary.text: Reduces the false-alert rate seen by advisers, reported against the documented quarterly baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: The false-alert rate seen by advisers fell from 31 percent in Q1 to 18 percent in Q4 after the threshold recalibration I proposed was adopted in version 3.2, as measured on the labelled review set and reported against the documented Q1 baseline of 31 percent.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinates release decisions with the model team and adviser operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated release decisions in the model release meeting; the model team lead took the go/no-go decision and adviser operations confirmed the alert-volume impact.

professionalSummary.text: Documents evaluation assumptions, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each model version.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing the review-set composition, the known limitation that alerts on newly onboarded portfolios were under-represented, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.

experienceHighlights.text: Added 1,200 newly labelled alerts to the review set over the year.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the evaluation harness (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner) and the labelled review set of adviser-confirmed alerts, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year.

experienceHighlights.text: Published evaluation reports to the model team and adviser operations for four model versions released in the year.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the four model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report to the model team and adviser operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Reported false-alert rate against the documented Q1 baseline of 31 percent.
experienceHighlights.witness: The false-alert rate seen by advisers fell from 31 percent in Q1 to 18 percent in Q4 after the threshold recalibration I proposed was adopted in version 3.2, as measured on the labelled review set and reported against the documented Q1 baseline of 31 percent.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented the known limitation that alerts on newly onboarded portfolios were under-represented in the review set.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing the review-set composition, the known limitation that alerts on newly onboarded portfolios were under-represented, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Quarterly false-alert report showing rate per quarter, baseline line, and version 3.2 marker.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the quarterly false-alert report (rate per quarter, baseline line, version 3.2 marker) and the evaluation notes for version 3.2, with the batch runner's job identifiers as a verification trail.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Evaluation notes for version 3.2 including review-set composition, known limitation, and hand-over items.
